internet_problem.question: My internet is not working.
internet_problem.answer: Please check that your modem is powered on and that the WAN/Internet light is active. Then restart the modem and wait about 3 minutes. If the problem continues, please contact customer support.

slow_internet.question: My internet is very slow.
slow_internet.answer: Please restart your modem, disconnect devices that are not being used, and run an internet speed test. If the problem affects all devices and continues, please contact customer support.

password_reset.question: I forgot my account password.
password_reset.answer: You can reset your password through your customer account. If you cannot access your account, please contact customer support.

payment_problem.question: I have a problem with my payment.
payment_problem.answer: Please check your payment information and transaction status. If the payment was completed but your account was not updated, please contact customer support.

pricing.question: How much does your internet service cost?
pricing.answer: Please check the available internet plans and their current prices in your customer account or contact our sales team.

human_agent.question: I want to talk to a human.
human_agent.answer: Of course. I can connect you with a customer support agent.
